'''Luminara's lightsaber''' was the weapon carried by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]]. Trained as a Jedi Guardian, Unduli's weapon produced a [[Color/Legends|green]] blade when ignited, which was somewhat unusual as Guardians typically carried blue-bladed lightsabers.

==History==
[[File:Luminara-CoD.png|thumb|left|250px|Unduli facing Asajj Ventress.]]
Like all other [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learners in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Luminara Unduli constructed [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] based off [[Lacunas Subartuk's lightsaber|Lacunas Subartuk's]] along with other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] using records from the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]]. Her lightsaber was unique to other Jedi who constructed theirs based off Subartuk's because of the [[Manganese brass/Legends|manganese brass]] [[radiator]] [[Radiator casing|casing]], a treatment that prevents corrosion.<ref name="Lightsabers" /> Unduli wielded her green-bladed weapon before and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], seeing action on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]],<ref name="Ep II" /> [[Nadiem/Legends|Nadiem]], [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], and [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="Ep III">{{Film|III}}</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name"NEC">[[The New Essential Chronology|''The New Essential Chronology'']]</ref> after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]],<ref name="Ep II" /> Unduli and her apprentice [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]]<ref name="Power of the Jedi">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> traveled to Ilum so that Offee could construct her lightsaber. The two were then ambushed by [[Spelunker probe droid/Legends|droids]], and utilized [[Form III/Legends|Form III]] lightsaber combat with their weapons to repel the droids, but the two ended up at the bottom of the [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Crystal Caves]] using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to prevent them from being hit by the debris.<ref name="CW Chapter 14">{{CW|14}}</ref>

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] Unduli was tasked with escorting [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] from Rodia to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to stand trial. She, along with Jedi Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Clone Commander/Legends]] [[Gree (clone trooper)|Gree]], and [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Faro Argyus/Legends|Faro Argyus]] escorted Gunray to the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Jedi cruiser]], [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']], but the ship soon fell under [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|attack]]. In the reactor room, Unduli wielded her weapon when she faced off against the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. She was soon backed up by Tano, who helped to fend off Ventress, but the latter escaped and freed the Viceroy.<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

The lightsaber would see [[Mission to Alzoc III|action]] against Ventress yet again on the icy world of [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]], where Unduli and fellow Jedi [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] dueled and defeated the Dark Acolyte by sealing her in an ice cave.<ref name="Republic Heroes">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref>

She later wielded it during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], during which she and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Buzz/Legends|Buzz]] tracked [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] to the [[Progate Temple/Legends|Progate Temple]]. While contacting Generals [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Kenobi]], and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Mundi]], she was attacked and knocked out by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[zombie]]s. When Kenobi and Skywalker arrived with reinforcements, they discovered her lightsaber, a discovery which concerned the Jedi as a Jedi such as Luminara would never leave the weapon lying around. Skywalker carried Unduli's lightsaber on his [[Belt/Legends|belt]], briefly wielding it in conjunction with his own, before returning it to Luminara.<ref name="Legacy of Terror">{{TCW|Legacy of Terror}}</ref>
Unduli continued to brandish her green lightsaber in combat, in battles on Nadiem and Kashyyyk. On Kashyyyk, Unduli fought with the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] population in defending their home. But [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], secretly [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, issued to the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which demanded the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of all Jedi as traitors to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="Ep III" /> Focused on the healing of injured Wookiees and clones, Unduli was unaware of her imminent danger and was shot down by her troops before she could react.<ref name="Ep III Comic">[[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith 4|''Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith'' 4]]</ref>
